A masking plan: roles and named specs in one object

Source: R/plan.R
masque_plan.Rd

Holds what a mask() call needs apart from the table: the roles, the coordinate and event declarations, the conditioning choice and any named control_spec()s. mask(df, plan) reads them from the plan; an argument passed to mask() as well overrides the plan's value for that call.

Usage

masque_plan(
  roles,
  coords = NULL,
  events = NULL,
  conditional = FALSE,
  ladder = c("hierarchy", "levels"),
  grain = TRUE,
  alias_names = FALSE,
  controls = NULL
)

Arguments

roles

A roles table from propose_roles().

coords, events, conditional, ladder, grain, alias_names

As in mask().

controls

NULL, one control_spec(), or a named list of them. A single spec is named default.

Value

A masque_plan object.

Details

At mask() each control spec is resolved on the source table and written back: its unit, its strata, the grain of its columns and its effect vector. The clone does not depend on the specs. The resolved plan is on the recipe, and clone_plan() gives the same plan in clone vocabulary for the analyst.

A spec's unit, where not declared, resolves to the coarsest design partition within which on is constant, or to the row. Its strata, where not declared, resolve to the finest design partition above the unit in which every stratum holds every level of on, or to none. A stratum that misses levels of on would keep part of the real effect in a negative control, so incomplete blocks are not chosen by default. Declare a whole-plot unit where few plots hold more than one row: it is taken only when a quarter of the rows share a unit.

A drawn effect, list(sd = ), is drawn over the clone's labels and shows nothing of the source. A declared effect is written to the clone plan as given, so values that rise with a level reveal that level's rank.

See also

mask(), clone_plan(), save_plan(), controls(), handover().

Examples

trial <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "john_alpha.csv", package = "masque"))
r <- propose_roles(trial, mode = "local", detect = FALSE)
r <- set_role(r, c("rep", "block"), role = "design", action = "keep")
r <- set_role(r, "gen", role = "treatment", action = "alias")
r <- set_role(r, "yield", role = "outcome", action = "scramble")
r <- set_role(r, c("plot", "row", "col"), role = "id", action = "keep")
p <- masque_plan(
  r,
  conditional = "design",
  controls = control_spec(
    on = "gen", target = "yield", effect = list(sd = 0.5), n = 5L, seed = 7L
  )
)
p
#> 
#> ── masque_plan (source vocabulary) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Roles: 2 design, 1 treatment, 1 outcome, 3 id
#> • Conditional: design
#> • Ladder: hierarchy; grain: TRUE
#> • Column names aliased: FALSE
#> • Coordinate pairs: 0
#> • Linked-event specs: 0
#> • Control specs: 1
#> default
#>   on gen, unit row
#>   strata none
#>   target yield; replicates: 5
m <- mask(trial, p, mode = "local", seed = 1L)
#> Warning: Conditional clone: cells of the finest conditioning stratum held fewer than 5 rows, so the ladder coarsened it by dropping block. Conditioning on: rep. The main effect of block is carried into the clone as an additive shift; its interaction with a kept treatment is not.
clone_plan(m)
#> 
#> ── masque_plan (clone vocabulary) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Roles: 2 design, 1 treatment, 1 outcome, 3 id
#> • Conditional: design
#> • Ladder: hierarchy; grain: TRUE
#> • Column names aliased: FALSE
#> • Coordinate pairs: 0
#> • Linked-event specs: 0
#> • Control specs: 1
#> default
#>   on gen, unit row
#>   strata rep
#>   target yield; replicates: 5
